changeSet.sql: UPDATE finishing_materials SET retail_net = ROUND(retail_net, 2), retail_gross = ROUND(retail_gross, 2), purchase_price = ROUND(purchase_price, 2) WHERE (retail_net IS NOT NULL AND retail_net <> ROUND(retail_net, 2)) OR (retail_gross IS NOT NULL AND retail_gross <> ROUND(retail_gross, 2)) OR (purchase_price IS NOT NULL AND purchase_price <> ROUND(purchase_price, 2));

UPDATE construction_materials SET retail_net = ROUND(retail_net, 2), retail_gross = ROUND(retail_gross, 2), purchase_price = ROUND(purchase_price, 2) WHERE (retail_net IS NOT NULL AND retail_net <> ROUND(retail_net, 2)) OR (retail_gross IS NOT NULL AND retail_gross <> ROUND(retail_gross, 2)) OR (purchase_price IS NOT NULL AND purchase_price <> ROUND(purchase_price, 2));
